selectedCommandContracts.guard: Exact terminal parent decision or receiver-fenced cancellation proof; settle only the matching operation/generation, never release because of time/missing read. A canceled parent fences local completion; record terminal source-use settlement even when acquire has not yet arrived, so delayed acquisition cannot recreate authority. Derive Disposition from the proven terminal source: parent_closed installs its generation closure fence, canceled clears only this use after parent fence, irreversible_decision releases the pinned source after historical decision. Never clear a use into an unrestricted writable child after parent closure.

identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant-scoped (campaignId, personId); the identity is established by the admitting owner or reactor named in the choreography, never by a caller request key; mutations bind CommandId to this exact identity.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
commandNote: Owner has no HTTP command of its own. See misattributed: acknowledgement/waiver/training are HTTP on the campaign admission and applied here by ApplyPolicyParticipantResult.

productRules.rule: An acknowledgement records that the person read, understood, and agrees to comply with the exact policy version identified by version and content hash, and stores the exact text shown (the organization's text if an Org Admin replaced the default).
An acknowledgement item is in exactly one state of pending, acknowledged, overdue, excepted, or removed.
New joiners must acknowledge within 30 days of their start date; everyone else re-acknowledges annually and whenever a new major policy version is approved.

decides: An acknowledgement records the exact policy version by version and content hash and the exact text shown (the organization's text if an Org Admin replaced the default). Item state is exactly one of pending, acknowledged, overdue, excepted, or removed. New joiners are due within 30 days of start date; others re-acknowledge annually and on each new major version. A mover_out or leaver moves to removed with earlier completions retained.
